args.sql:
SELECT 
    r.casenum,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'fraud_flags')::int as fraud_flags,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'risk_level') as risk_level,
    CASE 
        WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'risk_level') = 'Low' THEN 1
        WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'risk_level') = 'Medium' THEN 2
        WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'risk_level') = 'High' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END as w_risk,
    (jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'fraud_flags')::int * 
    CASE 
        WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'risk_level') = 'Low' THEN 1
        WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'risk_level') = 'Medium' THEN 2
        WHEN jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'risk_level') = 'High' THEN 3
        ELSE 0
    END) as FFS
FROM returns r
WHERE jsonb_extract_path_text(r.return_details, 'fraud', 'risk_level') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY FFS DESC
LIMIT 20;
